title: Answer: falsifiable at elements 119 and 120, at 1088 GeV, and at Z = 171 and 172

statements.text: The capacity paper names its falsifiers: selection rules for the alpha-decay chains of elements 119 and 120 (JINR, HIAF), a resonance at 1088 GeV at the High-Luminosity LHC, and a terminal $s$-doublet at $Z = 171, 172$ in simulation.

prediction.resolution_criterion: The High-Luminosity LHC observes a resonance at 1088 GeV.

sources.quote: The framework is falsifiable at $Z=119,120$ (JINR/HIAF), at $1088$ GeV (HL-LHC), and in silico at $Z=171,172$ (terminal $s$-doublet).
